text: 俄罗斯总统普京22日签署一系列总统令，批准了包括副总理、政府部长和总统助理在内的多个岗位人事任命。根据俄法律文书网站上发布的相关总统令内容，普京任命安东·西卢安诺夫为副总理兼财政部长，任命伊琳娜·奥克拉德尼科娃为副总理兼政府办公厅主任，任命奥列格·科热米亚科为副总理兼俄总统驻远东联邦区全权代表，任命安德烈·尼基京为副总理。文件显示，普京还任命尤里·特鲁特涅夫为总统助理，任命德米特里·亚德罗夫为交通部长。
text_en: Russian President Putin signed a series of presidential decrees on the 22nd approving appointments to multiple posts including deputy prime ministers, government ministers and presidential aides. According to the relevant presidential decrees published on Russia's legal documents website, Putin appointed Anton Siluanov as Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister, Irina Okladnikova as Deputy Prime Minister and Chief of the Government Staff, Oleg Kozhemyako as Deputy Prime Minister and Plenipotentiary Representative of the Russian President in the Far Eastern Federal District, and Andrei Nikitin as Deputy Prime Minister. The documents show that Putin also appointed Yuri Trutnev as Presidential Aide and Dmitry Yadrov as Transport Minister.
